variant_decisions.evidence: Qere כְּתָב and ketiv כתוב are both the masculine singular imperative of כתב 'write', differing only in orthography, and ASV renders 'write thee the name of the day' for either. The only note on EZK.24.2 is a hebrew_gloss ('Hebrew leaned upon') attached to 'drew close', which bears on a different word and is not a textual note. Nothing in the English distinguishes the two spellings, so both remain compatible and the qere base fallback carries the projection.
